findings.title: PR description cites nonexistent issue numbers and a false fix claim for #1093
findings.claim: The PR description references issues #1085, #1086, #1091, #1093, #1106 which do not exist in dkropachev/tidepool and appear to be upstream numbers; specifically the claim that #1093 'rejects dim < 1 in the metadata parsers' does not hold, since frame.go:862 still discards the Atoi error and never bounds dim, making this PR's negative-dimension check the only defense in this repo.

findings.title: PR description falsely claims all new tests fail against pristine marshal.go/helpers.go
findings.claim: The claim that 'every new test fails against pristine marshal.go/helpers.go' is inaccurate, since TestUnmarshalVectorAcceptsWellFormedPayloads and TestUnmarshalVectorZeroDimensionsDoesNotTouchSubType pass on main and are regression guards rather than reproductions.

findings.title: PR description includes 'Generated with Claude Code' attribution footer
findings.claim: The PR description's 'Generated with Claude Code' line contradicts the user's global CLAUDE.md rule against adding Claude/Anthropic attribution.

findings.title: helpers.go:280 change alters String() output for all unknown class names, not just…
findings.claim: The change at helpers.go:280 affects every unknown class name reaching getCassandraLongType (tuple, UDT, and collection element types too), altering String() text from custom() to custom(<name>), but the reviewer considers this consistent with frame.go:804 behavior and not a defect since nothing compares custom == "".
